result:
I compared run.R against every numbered and lettered item of MANIFEST.md and wrote CHECK.md in the working directory.

The script matches the manifest on the roster, all individual recodes and their branches, the sample steps, survey-level variables including status carry-back and the U22 and N01 variants, standardization and its branches, model terms and year references, Laplace and ML settings, the benchmark and wild bootstrap, the per-run model lists, influence handling, failure capture, and the output columns and term names.

CHECK.md lists one unmet item:

- **Section 8, run-ID argument.** The "all" option excludes the influence runs, and "all,influence" is rejected as an unknown run ID, so the complete ordered run set cannot be requested with "all". See run.R lines 300 to 302.
